entries.rationale: BW Sek-I exact source goal 'Einfache additive Gleichungen durch Umkehraufgaben loesen' presupposes whole-number addition; the direct broad arithmetic source row stays partial, but the prerequisite is a reviewed logical coverage surrogate.

BW Sek-I exact source goal 'Teilbarkeitsregeln pruefen und Primfaktorzerlegungen angeben' presupposes multiplication and division with natural and whole numbers; the broader arithmetic row remains partial.
BW Sek-I exact source goal 'Absolute und relative Haeufigkeiten bestimmen und darstellen' explicitly relies on switching between fractional, decimal, and percentage representations.
BW Sek-I exact source goal 'Umfang und Flaecheninhalt unterscheiden und in Figuren anwenden' presupposes calculating with quantities and interpreting units in measurement contexts.
BW Sek-I exact source goal 'Flaecheninhalte ebener Figuren berechnen und anschaulich begruenden' presupposes recognizing and using basic properties of quadrilaterals.
BW Sek-I exact source goal 'Koordinaten und Schraegbilder im Raum verwenden' presupposes basic coordinate representations of points, segments, lines, and circles.
BW Sek-I exact source goal 'Potenzgesetze begruenden und anwenden' presupposes translating simple situations into variable terms before algebraic power laws can be applied.
BW Sek-I exact source goal 'Den Ableitungsbegriff aus mittleren Aenderungsraten entwickeln' presupposes describing linear functions as the prior model for constant rates of change.
BW Sek-I exact source goal 'Kugelformeln geometrisch deuten und anwenden' uses the canonical route through rotational solids and cylinder volume as prerequisite measurement knowledge.
BW Sek-I exact source goal 'Bernoulli-Experimente und Bernoulli-Ketten beschreiben' presupposes treating random variables and distributions as a modelling frame.
BW Sek-I exact source goal 'Ableitungen von Sinus und Kosinus angeben und nutzen' presupposes describing sine and cosine as periodic functions.
